A literal line ending inside a code span folds to a space, per CommonMark

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>see <code>a\nb</code> here</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
